root_cause: The explicit entrypoint invoked vllm via runpy at top level. Python multiprocessing spawn re-imported the entry file during child bootstrap and recursively attempted to start another engine, raising the safe-import RuntimeError before EngineCore initialization completed.
corrective_action: Keep v7 patch installation at module import time so spawned children receive it, but guard vLLM API-server startup with if __name__ == '__main__'.
